summary: Generic SecurityExecutionEngine bridge is implemented as security_execution::engine. It provides a single prepare, execute, observe, verify, seal, rollback, and explain API over ToolRouter, PolicyEvaluator, CapabilityLease, lease-derived sandbox profiles, EffectEnvelope, AuditJournal, and write-with-diff rollback preparation.

acceptance.criterion: AgentCore has one execution API for all effects.
acceptance.evidence: security_execution::engine::SecurityExecutionEngine exposes prepare, execute, observe, verify, seal, rollback, and explain; DefaultSecurityExecutionEngine implements the API over existing safety components.

acceptance.criterion: Denied and paused steps do not prepare effects.
acceptance.evidence: security_execution::engine::tests::denied_and_paused_steps_do_not_prepare_effects verifies denied shell.exec and paused svc.restart return no EffectEnvelope and no EffectPrepared audit entry.

acceptance.criterion: Prepared write steps include rollback handles.
acceptance.evidence: security_execution::engine::tests::write_with_diff_prepares_rollback_handle_and_rolls_back_failed_verification verifies fs.write.diff prepare creates PreparedWrite and EffectEnvelope rollback_handle before execution.

acceptance.criterion: Read-only steps run under sandbox profile.
acceptance.evidence: security_execution::engine::tests::read_only_step_runs_under_sandbox_and_seals verifies read-only svc.status compiles a sandbox binding, executes through SandboxExecutor, and seals after verification.

acceptance.criterion: Execution errors are auditable and recoverable.
acceptance.evidence: SecurityExecutionError exposes failure_class mappings, write base/hash mismatch maps to rollback-pending/fail-closed classes, sandbox denied reports are recorded, and rollback path emits RollbackPending and RollbackObserved.

prepare_pipeline: ToolRouter routes PlanStep semantic tool call
PolicyEvaluator records PolicyEvaluated and issues CapabilityLease only for allow decisions
Denied and awaiting-approval outcomes return without EffectEnvelope
Read-only leases compile sandbox profiles from leases
Write-with-diff leases prepare shadow diff and rollback handle before EffectEnvelope prepare
EffectEnvelope prepare writes EffectPrepared only after policy, lease, sandbox, and rollback prerequisites are satisfied
safety_ordering: execute rejects calls without a prepared envelope
read-only execution uses SandboxExecutor and produces no persistent write path
write-with-diff execution requires matching path, base_hash, and content_hash
verify failure for write-with-diff enters RollbackPending
rollback restores from rollback handle and records RollbackObserved
